docs.title: Starflake ontology
docs.text:
Domain ontology for Starflake, an open-world 3D space explorer.

The pilot flies a ship through a galaxy of star systems, shoots enemies and asteroids, loots the fuel they drop, and jumps to a neighbouring system once the tank holds enough fuel.

The schema has two layers:

  • Content (ContentPack): static, designer-authored definitions such as ship classes, weapons, enemy and asteroid types, and the galaxy map.
  • State (GameSession): the persisted, replicable state of one play session, which references content by identifier.

Units: distances in metres, time in seconds, angles in radians.

URI: https://w3id.org/M4jor-Tom/starflake-ontology

Name: starflake-ontology

docs.title: starflake-ontology
docs.text:
Domain ontology for Starflake, an open-world 3D space explorer.

The pilot flies a ship through a galaxy of star systems, shoots enemies and asteroids, loots the fuel they drop, and jumps to a neighbouring system once the tank holds enough fuel.

The schema has two layers:

  • Content (ContentPack): static, designer-authored definitions such as ship classes, weapons, enemy and asteroid types, and the galaxy map.
  • State (GameSession): the persisted, replicable state of one play session, which references content by identifier.

Units: distances in metres, time in seconds, angles in radians.

URI: https://w3id.org/M4jor-Tom/starflake-ontology
